quota.label: Storage
welcome.title: Welcome to Hoard
welcome.tagline: Cloud sync for your game saves. Hoard runs quietly in the background and uploads new saves whenever you finish playing.
welcome.bullet_1: Detects games you have installed automatically.
welcome.bullet_2: Backs up after each session, never while a game is running.
welcome.bullet_3: Restores any past version with two clicks.
choose.title: How do you want to sign in?
choose.subtitle: Use Hoard Cloud with your Google account, or connect to your own self-hosted server.
choose.selfhost_desc: Connect to a Hoard server you run yourself.
choose.cloud_desc: Use Hoard Cloud — nothing to set up.
server.title: Connect to your server
server.subtitle: Paste the address of the Hoard server you (or your admin) set up.
server.address_hint: The same URL you would open in a web browser.
server.unreachable_body: Hoard couldn't connect to {url}. If this server is gone for good, forget it so Hoard stops trying to reconnect.
server.invalid_url: Address must start with http:// or https://
token.title: Sign in
token.subtitle: Paste the access key for your account on
token.access_key_hint: Your server admin can create one with `hoard-admin token create <username>`.
token.invalid_key: That doesn't look like a Hoard access key. It should start with `hoard_v1_` followed by 64 lowercase hex characters.
onboarding_done.subtitle: Hoard now has everything it needs to keep your saves in sync.
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.tracked_count: {count, plural, one {# tracked save} other {# tracked saves}}
dashboard.no_saves_body: Head to the Library and pick a game — Hoard will auto-back-up its saves whenever they change.
dashboard.tooltip_paused: This save is paused — open History to resume
dashboard.tooltip_force_paused: Upload now (paused — this manual upload is one-off)
library.title: Library
library.subtitle_scanned: Scanned {catalog} catalog entries — found {found} on this machine
library.subtitle_initial: Scan your machine to find games whose save folders Hoard knows about.
library.no_results_empty: Nothing detected yet. Try installing a few games or running a deeper scan.
library.no_save_yet_toast: No save folder yet — start the game once, then re-scan to track it.
library.no_scan_title: No scan yet on this session.
library.no_scan_body: Hoard will check ~10,000 catalog entries against your filesystem and Steam library. The first scan takes 10–30 seconds.
library.deep_scan_hint: Looks where the normal scan doesn't: Wine/Proton prefixes, Flatpak, Snap, emulators.
library.auto_restored_toast: Restored {name} from the cloud (v{version}, {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}).
library.backup_skipped_empty_toast: Didn't back up {name}: the save folder is empty. Turn on auto-restore in Settings if you want the cloud copy pulled back instead.
library.tracked_size_title: Total bytes stored on the server (sum of snapshots)
history.not_found_hint: It may have been removed from this machine.
history.no_backups_body: Your first backup runs as soon as the game writes new save data — or hit "Back up now" above.
history.cloud_no_file_index: Couldn't load the file list for this version (the download may have failed or hit the bandwidth limit). The snapshot is intact.
history.restore_description: Files in {path} will be overwritten with the contents of this version.
history.backup_first_hint: Recommended. Saves what's in the folder right now as a fresh version, so you can roll back if you restored the wrong one.
history.restore_warning: Restore overwrites the current files. If the game is running, quit it first or your progress in this session may be lost.
history.delete_description: The version stays recoverable from the trash for the server's retention window (default 30 days). After that it's gone for good.
history.delete_body: Deleted versions don't count against your storage quota and can be recovered from the "Show recoverable" toggle above this list.
history.cloud_delete_title: Delete this save from the cloud?
history.cloud_delete_description: Hoard Cloud keeps only the latest version, so this removes the whole save and frees the space it used.
history.cloud_delete_body: This is permanent — the cloud copy can't be recovered. Your local files stay untouched.
history.edit_folder_description: Tell Hoard where this save lives now. Use the full path to the folder, exactly as it appears in your file manager.
presets.label: Preset
presets.standard.label: Standard
presets.short_session.label: Short session
presets.short_session.desc: Frequent restores and backups — best for short-round games like R.E.P.O.
presets.backup_only.label: Backup only
presets.backup_only.desc: Never auto-restore; only upload new progress.
presets.data_saver.label: Data saver
history.restored_toast: {count, plural, one {Restored v{version} — # file{safety}.} other {Restored v{version} — # files{safety}.}}
history.index_subtitle: Pick a save to see its version timeline, restore an older copy, or recover deleted versions.
history.index_empty_body: Track a game from the Library and its backup history will show up here.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Tweak how Hoard behaves on this machine. Changes are saved as soon as you toggle them.
settings.mode_backup_desc: Uploads your saves to the cloud. Restoring is always manual — it never downloads on its own.
settings.mode_sync_desc: Play on one machine, continue on another. Automatic upload and download with conflict protection.
settings.scan_interval_hint: How often Hoard re-scans for newly installed games. Cheap — it reads no save data.
settings.backup_interval_hint: How often Hoard re-checks tracked saves for changes. The work is spread out over time to keep disk use low.
settings.conflict_retention_hint: Saved in ~/.local/share/hoard/conflicts/. Older copies are deleted automatically.
settings.data_saving_hint: Higher means fewer versions and longer gaps between snapshots, using less disk. Lower captures every change. Pinned versions and the latest one are always kept.
settings.auto_restore_label: Restore from cloud when a save folder is empty
settings.auto_restore_desc: When you add a tracked save and the local folder is missing or empty (fresh install, new machine), Hoard pulls the latest server snapshot in the background. Off by default — leave off unless you trust the agent to write into your home folder unattended.
settings.close_to_tray_desc: Closing the window keeps Hoard running in the background so backups continue. Quit from the tray icon to stop it.
settings.autostart_desc: Adds Hoard to your launcher. Pair with “Start minimised” for a quiet boot.
settings.start_minimised_desc: Launch with the window hidden — only the tray icon shows up.
settings.telemetry_desc: Help us see how many people are using Hoard. We only count events (successful backup, restore, first-run completed) — never your username, game names, save paths, file contents, or tokens. Off by default.
settings.notify_success_desc: A small desktop notification when a backup uploads successfully. Turn this off once you trust the agent.
settings.notify_failure_desc: Alerts you when a backup fails, even after retries. We strongly recommend leaving this on.
settings.forget_server_desc: This connection (address + access token) is saved on your device and the OS keychain, so it's restored every time Hoard starts — even after a reinstall. Forget it to remove the saved credentials so Hoard stops trying to reach this server.
settings.forget_confirm_body: Hoard will delete the saved address and access token for {url}. Your snapshots on the server aren't touched — you can connect again later with the address and a token.
settings.autostart_rejected: The OS rejected the autostart change — try enabling autostart from your launcher settings.
settings.language_desc: Choose the language Hoard uses for menus, buttons, and messages.
settings.catalog_desc: Hoard auto-detects games using the Ludusavi catalog. We refresh it weekly in the background — hit the button to pull the latest list now.
settings.view_logs_desc: Inspect the agent's activity log. Handy for bug reports.
settings.about_line_2: Your server, your data. Source code & docs at hoard.dev.
logs.title: Logs
logs.subtitle: Tail of the most recent agent log. Useful for bug reports — hit "Copy" to get the visible lines on your clipboard.
logs.empty_no_logs: The agent hasn't written any logs yet on this machine.
library.no_save_alert_aria: No save folder detected — click for details
library.no_save_alert_title: Hoard doesn't know where {name} stores saves
library.no_save_alert_body: We detected {name} via Steam but couldn't find a save folder yet — either the game hasn't been launched on this machine, or it writes saves to a path that isn't in our catalog. Pick the folder manually and Hoard will track it from there.
library.untrack_confirm_body: Hoard will stop watching this folder. Snapshots already on the server stay intact — you can restore them later or wipe them from the History page.
library.delete_confirm_body: This wipes every snapshot of {name} from the server. Local files are left alone. The action cannot be undone. After deleting, the game can be re-scanned and added again from Library.
library.rename_modal_body: Pick a new label for this save. The on-disk snapshot folder is renamed too, so future restores keep pointing to the same data.
library.rename_error_conflict: Another save for this game already uses that label. Pick a different one.
library.manual_path_set: Hoard will remember the folder you picked for {name}.
library.ignore_body: {name} will stop appearing in this session.
library.ignore_blacklist_check: Add to permanent blacklist (don't detect again)
history.choose_destination_description: Hoard doesn't know a save folder for this game on this machine yet. Pick a folder and we'll create it if it doesn't exist.
history.pick_destination_dialog_title: Choose a folder for the restored save
automatic.title: Automatic Mode
automatic.activated: Automatic mode is on: periodic scans and auto-restore are enabled.
automatic.help_tooltip: When on, Hoard scans every N hours and keeps auto-restore enabled.
automatic.subtitle_on: Periodic scanning and auto-restore are active.
automatic.subtitle_off: Turn on for automatic scanning and restore.
automatic.nothing_new: Nothing new to track. You're all set.
automatic.tracked_summary: {count, plural, one {Tracked # game — agent running.} other {Tracked # games — agent running.}}
automatic.conflicts_backed_up: {count, plural, one {1 local file was older than the cloud copy. Local version saved to {dir} before overwrite.} other {# local files were older than the cloud copy. Local versions saved to {dir} before overwrite.}}
sync.title: Sync
sync.help_tooltip: When on, Hoard downloads a newer cloud version the moment your device is outdated — even while you're playing.
updates.client_available: Hoard {latest} is out — click to install.
updates.server_available: Your server is on an older Hoard ({latest} available) — click for the upgrade command.
updates.client_body: The Hoard app is on {current}. Install {latest}? The OS installer will ask for confirmation.
updates.server_body: Your server is on {current}; the latest is {latest}. The server doesn't self-update — run this command on your server to upgrade:
updates.installer_launched: Installer launched — follow the system prompt to finish.
updates.superseded: Operation cancelled: a newer version ({latest}) is available. Update again to install it.
updates.downloaded_manual: Downloaded to {path}. Open it to install.
updates.server_command_copied: Command copied — run it on your server.
updates.server_command_manual: Run `sudo hoard-server upgrade` on your server.
updates.notification_body: Version {latest} is out — open Hoard to install.
updates.error.title: Update error
updates.error.no_installer: This release is still being built. Please wait about 5 minutes and try again.
updates.error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred during the update.
updates.error.server_unknown: An unexpected error occurred while upgrading the server.
updates.error.server_pkexec_failed: Could not elevate privileges to upgrade the server.
updates.error.server_not_logged_in: Sign in to your server first.
updates.error.server_unreachable: Couldn't reach the server to request the upgrade.
updates.error.server_forbidden: The server rejected the upgrade request. You need an admin account, and the server must allow remote upgrades.
updates.server_upgrade_partial: Server updated. Restart the service when you can.
settings.server_section_desc: Status of the self-hosted server you're signed into. Cloud-hosted instances handle updates themselves and won't show this panel.
settings.server_update_available: An update is available — server is behind v{latest}.
settings.server_probe_failed: Couldn't reach the server. Check it's running and reachable.
settings.server_command_copied: Command copied — run it on your server.
settings.server_command_manual: Run `sudo hoard-server upgrade` on your server.
settings.server_upgrade_hint: You'll be asked for your password — Hoard runs the upgrade on your server with elevated privileges and restarts the service afterwards.
settings.server_upgrade_partial: Server upgraded, but the restart didn't go through ({error}). Restart it yourself when it's safe to.
settings.server_remote_upgrade_hint: Hoard asks your server to upgrade itself and restart — no SSH needed. Works from any device as long as you're an admin.
settings.server_remote_upgrade_confirmed: Server upgraded to v{version} and back online.
settings.server_remote_upgrade_scheduled: Upgrade requested. The server is restarting — re-check in a moment to confirm the new version.

diagnostics.heading: Live agent slots
diagnostics.subtitle: Snapshot of every save the live agent is watching. Hidden panel — refreshes every 2 seconds while open.
diagnostics.agent_stopped: Agent isn't running. Sign in to start it.
diagnostics.title: Detection diagnostics
diagnostics.no_trace: Run a diagnosis to see the pipeline trace.
settings.account_desc: Sign in to sync your saves with Hoard Cloud.
account.title: Account
account.signin_subtitle: Sync your saves across devices. No setup, no server to run.
account.signin_hint: We open your browser so you can sign in with Google, GitHub, Discord or Apple.
account.session_expired: Your Hoard Cloud session expired. Sign in again.
account.feature_storage_body: Up to 50 GB on Pro, with forever version history.
account.feature_sync_body: Unlimited devices on Pro, no manual file shuffling.
account.feature_privacy_body: Export everything any time. Cancel and walk away with your saves.
account.selfhost_body: Hoard works just as well against a server you host yourself.
account.data_section_body: Export every save you've ever uploaded as a single archive. We email you a link when it's ready.
account.export_queued: Export queued (#{id}). We'll email you the link.
account.danger_zone_body: Sign out or delete your account. Deletion is reversible for 30 days.
account.delete_modal_body: Your account, every save and every device link will be removed.
account.delete_modal_grace: We keep a copy for 30 days in case you change your mind. After that it's gone.
upgrade.title: Compare plans
upgrade.subtitle: Pick the tier that fits your library. Cancel anytime.
settings.cloud_savings_mode_desc: New cloud saves upload from this device but stay hidden from your other devices' auto-sync — useful for a laptop you treat as a backup vault. Per-save overrides live on each game's card.
cloud_error.save_too_large: This save is {requested}, but your plan caps uploads at {limit} per save. Trim the folder or upgrade to Pro for 2 GB per save.
cloud_error.bandwidth_exceeded: Bandwidth limit reached ({limit} per {window}). Try again in {retry}.
cloud_error.storage_exceeded: Storage full — {used} of {limit} used. Free up space or upgrade your plan.
cloud_error.generic: Something went wrong talking to Hoard Cloud. Try again in a moment.
settings.cloud_poll_hint: How often Hoard polls the server for new save versions. Changes now arrive instantly via push, so this is just a backup check — default 60s. Shorter feels snappier; longer is gentler if you're on a slow network.
settings.live_activity_desc: Floating panel in the bottom-right that lists recent backups, restores and cloud pulls.
activity.empty: Nothing yet — launch a game and you'll see it land here.
map.title: Save map
map.subtitle: A constellation of your games — each branch is a playthrough, each node a save.
map.empty_body: Track a game and create some saves; they will show up here as orbs with branches.
